summary: Recreate from the Operations panel keeps the deployment's secrets; the maintenance-page check works inside composer-agent.
highlights: Inside composer-agent (the Operations panel's check and apply) the maintenance-page check reads the runtime volume instead of an exec the socket proxy refuses.
Recreating a service from the Operations panel loads the deployment's secrets; before, the new container ran on compose defaults.

Includes 1.7.0b4: the repair preview lists the maintenance-page migration. Includes 1.7.0b3: logs of every service. Includes 1.7.0b2: service operations. Includes 1.7.0b1: the maintenance page ships in this image.
